To tell the truth, I heard a concerning rumor the other day.
Before anything happens, I want to show her a real race.

Fufu, pardon me for surprising you out of the blue.
I am Biwa Hayahide. Narita Brian's older sister.
Then staying here any longer is—

W-What, why?! Our academy was way better than your last one, wasn't it?!
We have a track just like the real thing, and you can practice at a higher level!

I am fully aware of how rude this was of me. However, I simply had to know.
Whether you are someone I can entrust my hopes to, or not.

*sniff*... You're just way too fast...
I haaate you... so much...!
Now then, shall we move to the main topic?

Still, there are plenty of opponents out there for you besides me.
So go on, don't worry about a thing and just enjoy yourself.

U-Um. Brian-chan, do you want to join a racing club next time?
There are lots of amazing runners there.

...Ugh... no way... anymore...
This is seriously the worst... why did a girl that fast have to come here...?!
...Before I knew it, I was keeping her company with her training.

...Kgh, give me a break!
Winning might be fun for you, but it sure isn't fun for me!

Above all, staying with me until this hour shows your dedication to putting Umamusume first.
...Yes, she will be in good hands with you.

Those were the Umamusume who had raced against Narita Brian before.
Perhaps they were training here as well.

Narita Brian... that girl runs remarkably well.
Though I hear she has drifted through quite a few racing clubs.
...Big sis.

Forgive me. I was testing you. According to my theories,
one's attitude toward training directly reflects their character.
Are you sure you really want to do this?
...Yeah.

(...That's not "it"! Push me harder!!
This is supposed to be a race, isn't it?! Giving up so easily—)

Number 8, Narita Brian, is watching like a hawk for her chance!
However, Number 6 continues to widen the lead!!
Impossi-ble... Ahh, even if I try my best, there's no way I can keep up.

Come to Tracen Academy. There, you will find real races.
...Perhaps it can satisfy that thirst of yours.

I happened to spot the trainer rumored to persistently approach Brian,
no matter how many times she gets rejected. I was eager to speak with you.

Thank you, I was able to gather excellent data. That wind sprint you suggested at the end was great, too.
An idea born from always contemplating what needs improvement, I presume?
Huh—

Please, there is no need to be so modest.
Could you spare me a little of your time?

—Would you please bring my little sister, Narita Brian,
to my Make Debut race?

...But next time, I can run even faster.
So let's run one more lap.
Huh...?

No. I won't find what I'm looking for here anymore.
...Competing in a race devoid of heat is completely pointless.

Indeed, I truly wonder why. Anyone who sees her raw talent
would never want to let her go, yet...
Taaaaaaahhh!!

...Brian, I'm sorry.
The doctor says I won't be able to run with you for a while.

...Yes. I don't want to repeat a blunder like that ever again.
That's why...
...Before her decision to drop out becomes final.

...No matter where I go, no matter who I challenge,
I'm never satisfied. The thirst only grows.
(Is it the same here, too?)

And they're off! The Tracen Academy Selection Race has begun!
Number 6 bursts out in front!

Haa... haa... Brian-chan,
you're too faaast...!
—I'm quitting today.
Haa... khh, haa... khh.

They say going for a walk is a good way to organize your thoughts.
Taking a stroll down along the riverbank alone on this day, I found...
...So this is where you were, Brian.
A few years later. At a certain racing club—

Phew, shall we cool down now?
I'd appreciate it if you could record the final time in blue pen.
Excuse me, do you have a moment?
